mapper.insert: MERGE diag_result_publish_version AS t USING ( SELECT #{row.tenantId} AS tenant_id, #{row.queryHash} AS query_hash, #{row.dataVersion} AS data_version ) AS s ON (t.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND t.query_hash = s.query_hash AND t.data_version = s.data_version) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET publish_status = #{row.publishStatus}, job_id = #{row.jobId}, error_summary = #{row.errorSummary}, published_time = COALESCE(#{row.publishedTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, t.published_time), update_time = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( tenant_id, query_hash, data_version, publish_status, job_id, error_summary, published_time ) VALUES ( #{row.tenantId}, #{row.queryHash}, #{row.dataVersion}, #{row.publishStatus}, #{row.jobId}, #{row.errorSummary}, #{row.publishedTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} );
mapper.select: SELECT TOP 1 id, tenant_id AS tenantId, query_hash AS queryHash, data_version AS dataVersion, publish_status AS publishStatus, job_id AS jobId, error_summary AS errorSummary, published_time AS publishedTime, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM diag_result_publish_version WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND query_hash = #{queryHash} AND publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY published_time DESC, update_time DESC, id DESC
